subject: literacy
concept: Summarizing a passage in a few sentences, including only the most important information
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student selects the 3 most important detail cards from a larger set after hearing a passage
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the sentence that best summarizes a short passage among several options
exercise.abstract: Student writes a 2-3 sentence summary of a passage in their own words

assessment.mastery_threshold: summary captures the main idea and at least one key detail, without excessive minor detail
misconception_flags: retells the entire passage rather than summarizing key points

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
